Fill "Keebler Inc | Fresh Flowers & Same Day Delivery" locator('//input[@id=\'txtAddNewCateMetaTitle\']')
Fill "wedding flowers, bridal bouquet, floral arrangements" locator('//textarea[@id=\'txtAddNewCatMetaKeywords\']')
Search and verify newly added category in grid
Navigate to Products -> Products menu on Web Admin page
Fill Out all fields on Add New Product popup and verify the product is created
